# Breadcrumb

A navigation aid that shows the current page's position within the site hierarchy and lets users backtrack to ancestor pages. Links use the neutral link color; the current page is a muted, non-interactive label; and a chevron separates each level. When the trail gets long it collapses the middle into an overflow (…) that opens a dropdown of the hidden links. Full RTL support. Modeled on Figma frames 5698:2597 (Breadcrumb) and 5698:2585 (Breadcrumb Item).

**Stylesheet:** `components/breadcrumbs/breadcrumbs.css`

**Behaviour:** `js/components/breadcrumbs.js` (classes `BreadcrumbManager`). Without it the markup renders but does not open, close or toggle.

Layout wrappers named `showcase-*` belong to the documentation page, not to the component: leave them out.

## Props / Configuration

Classes for composing a breadcrumb trail.

| Class / Attribute | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `.breadcrumb` | Container | The <nav> trail. Use aria-label="Breadcrumb". 14/20 regular text. |
| `.breadcrumb-item` | Item | Wraps a link, the current label, or the overflow toggle. |
| `.breadcrumb-link` | Link | Ancestor link — neutral color (#384250), underlines on hover. |
| `.breadcrumb-current` | Label | The current page — muted (#9DA4AE), non-interactive. Pair with aria-current="page". |
| `.breadcrumb-separator` | Slot | Chevron between items (#9DA4AE). Auto-flips in RTL. Mark aria-hidden="true". |
| `.breadcrumb-overflow` | Item | Collapsed-middle item holding the … toggle and a .menu dropdown of hidden links. |
| `.breadcrumb-overflow__toggle` | Trigger | The … button that opens the overflow dropdown (outside-click / ESC close). |

## Anatomy

Root link → middle links separated by chevrons → the current page as a muted label.

```html
<nav class="breadcrumb" aria-label="Breadcrumb">
    <span class="breadcrumb-item"><a href="#" class="breadcrumb-link">Home</a></span>
    <span class="breadcrumb-separator" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <path d="M6 4l4 4-4 4"></path>
        </svg></span>
    <span class="breadcrumb-item"><a href="#" class="breadcrumb-link">Services</a></span>
    <span class="breadcrumb-separator" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <path d="M6 4l4 4-4 4"></path>
        </svg></span>
    <span class="breadcrumb-item"><span class="breadcrumb-current" aria-current="page">Current Page</span></span>
</nav>
```

## Levels

The trail grows one level at a time. The last item is always the current page.

```html
<nav class="breadcrumb" aria-label="Breadcrumb">
    <span class="breadcrumb-item"><a href="#" class="breadcrumb-link">Home</a></span>
    <span class="breadcrumb-separator" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <path d="M6 4l4 4-4 4"></path>
        </svg></span>
    <span class="breadcrumb-item"><span class="breadcrumb-current" aria-current="page">Services</span></span>
</nav>
```

## Overflow Dropdown

A long trail collapses its middle into an overflow … that opens a dropdown of the hidden links (Figma "Middle-overflow open"). Click the … below.

```html
<nav class="breadcrumb" aria-label="Breadcrumb">
    <span class="breadcrumb-item"><a href="#" class="breadcrumb-link">Home</a></span>
    <span class="breadcrumb-separator" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <path d="M6 4l4 4-4 4"></path>
        </svg></span>
    <span class="breadcrumb-item breadcrumb-overflow">
        <button type="button" class="breadcrumb-overflow__toggle" aria-label="Show more links">…</button>
        <div class="menu" role="menu">
            <div class="menu-group">
                <a href="#" class="menu-item" role="menuitem"><span class="menu-item__label">Services</span></a>
                <a href="#" class="menu-item" role="menuitem"><span class="menu-item__label">Category</span></a>
                <a href="#" class="menu-item" role="menuitem"><span class="menu-item__label">Subcategory</span></a>
            </div>
        </div>
    </span>
    <span class="breadcrumb-separator" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <path d="M6 4l4 4-4 4"></path>
        </svg></span>
    <span class="breadcrumb-item"><a href="#" class="breadcrumb-link">Details</a></span>
    <span class="breadcrumb-separator" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <path d="M6 4l4 4-4 4"></path>
        </svg></span>
    <span class="breadcrumb-item"><span class="breadcrumb-current" aria-current="page">Current Page</span></span>
</nav>
```

## RTL Support

For Arabic, the trail reads right-to-left and the chevron separators flip direction automatically.

```html
<nav class="breadcrumb breadcrumb--rtl" dir="rtl" aria-label="Breadcrumb">
    <span class="breadcrumb-item"><a href="#" class="breadcrumb-link">الرئيسية</a></span>
    <span class="breadcrumb-separator" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <path d="M6 4l4 4-4 4"></path>
        </svg></span>
    <span class="breadcrumb-item"><a href="#" class="breadcrumb-link">الخدمات</a></span>
    <span class="breadcrumb-separator" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <path d="M6 4l4 4-4 4"></path>
        </svg></span>
    <span class="breadcrumb-item"><span class="breadcrumb-current" aria-current="page">تفاصيل الخدمة</span></span>
</nav>
```
